# Repository presentation

Description, website and topics below were applied through the GitHub API and verified by readback. The social preview image is prepared for manual upload.

## Description

Market-making research and a deterministic exchange simulator. Order-book signals, execution sensitivity, price-time matching, and crash recovery in a local Python workbench.

## Topics

`quantitative-finance`, `market-microstructure`, `market-making`, `limit-order-book`, `matching-engine`, `python`, `scikit-learn`, `simulation`

Use `docs/assets/portfolio-cover.png` (1280 × 640). Upload through GitHub repository Settings → Social preview. This file records the intended settings; it does not by itself apply repository metadata or upload a social preview.
